presentation.label: TAPE EMULATION
presentation.summary: Airwindows IronOxide5 on the DSP: tape-speed filtering and two stages of sine saturation, with input and output trim.
presentation.overview: IronOxide5 thins the low end with its tape-low filter, drives the signal into a sine saturator, smooths it through a leaky tape-speed integrator and limits it with a second sine stage. HIGH sets the tape speed (brighter and tighter as it rises), LOW the lean-out, INPUT the drive and OUT the level. MIX blends from dry at 0 to fully wet at 127. Flutter and noise are not implemented. It is a buffer-free insert for FX1 or FX2 on any track. This is a source draft: it is not in the catalog or the firmware builder.
highlights: Port of Airwindows IronOxide5 at Flutter and Noise 0, within 3.7e-4 of the plugin's own code, gain-staged for the Octatrack's FX input level
INPUT and OUT trims of -18 to +18 dB, tape speed 1.65 to 165 ips
MIX from dry to fully wet
185 executed instructions per sample: 29% below stock SPRING REV
usage: Assign IRONOXIDE5 in FUNC + FX2 (or FX1) SETUP with LEVEL and YES. Defaults are the plugin's: INPUT and OUT at 0 dB, 15 ips, fully wet.
Raise INPUT for more saturation and pull OUT down to match the level. HIGH darkens and loosens the sound as it falls; LOW thins the bass as it rises.
Turn MIX down from 127 to blend the tape sound with the dry track; 0 is dry.

controls.name: INPUT
controls.doc: Input trim, -18 dB at 0 to +18 dB at 127; 64 is 0 dB, the plugin default.

controls.name: HIGH
controls.doc: Tape speed: 1.65 to 165 ips as knob^4. Higher is brighter and tighter; 72 is the plugin's 15 ips.

controls.name: LOW
controls.doc: Tape low: higher values cut more low end before the saturator; 72 is the plugin default.

controls.name: OUT
controls.doc: Output trim of the wet signal, -18 dB at 0 to +18 dB at 127; 64 is 0 dB.

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: Dry/wet: 0 is dry, 127 fully wet (the plugin default). The plugin's knob also has an inverted half below dry, which is not used.

limitations: Draft only: not in the catalog, configurator or firmware builder until hardware qualification and owner review are complete.
Flutter and noise (the plugin's D and E) are not implemented; this is the plugin at D = E = 0.
OUT above 64 can drive the output past full scale; the DSP's output store limits it.

This revision rewrites the octabam build's per-sample path (see TESTING.md). OCTABAM3 and OCTABAM4 were flashed on 2 Oct 2026 (MIX not dry; then less saturation than the plugin). OCTABAM8, with the input level fixed, was flashed the same day and reported working (a listening test).
MIX covers the upper half of the plugin's inv/dry/wet knob (dry to wet); the inverted half is not available.
Effect ID 0x1e, priority 18 and layout letter 5 were checked free against the eleven Octamod modules and the TapeHead draft only.

storage.label: DSP program
storage.display: 654 words P, 28 words X per instance, no buffer
storage.conditions: Composed build report (both payloads place 654 words in the donor region). State, coefficients and staging use 28 words of the instance's own r7 block; no allocator buffer, no Y memory. SPRING REV: 1,063 words plus the 16,384-word FX2 instance buffer.

processing.label: DSP estimate
processing.conditions: tools/build/cycle_count.py static count of the sample loop. benchmark.py, executed instructions: 185/sample for one instance (SPRING REV 262); four per core worst 13,144 per 16-sample block (SPRING REV 20,376). Not a hardware load figure.

impact.conditions: One active instance at any setting; no stage is skipped, and the per-block coefficient fits cost the same in every segment.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a DSP insert with a cloned menu descriptor. The ColdFire only forwards five page-1 values.

dsp.rationale: 194 cycles/sample by the static counter, about 6% of the 3,120 cycles/core usable by modules. benchmark.py: 29% fewer executed instructions than stock SPRING REV for one instance and 35% fewer at the worst four-per-core case.

memory.rationale: 654 words of DSP program per payload and 28 words in each instance's existing r7 block. No allocator buffer or Y memory, where SPRING REV takes 1,063 words and a 16,384-word instance buffer.

tests.summary: verify.py renders the assembled module in dsp_host against the plugin's own float code: peak error 3.7e-4 over nine settings x seven signals at two input levels, the plugin's THD at the unit's level within 1 dB, exact silence, MIX 0 dry within 1 LSB at any setting, stereo independence and split blocks. The composed test image renders within 4.7e-5 at the defaults. Benchmarked against stock SPRING REV. Menu, init-register and replace gates pass; MKII emulator LCD captures included. OCTABAM3 was flashed on 2 Oct 2026; MIX 0 was not dry there (the plugin's inverted half), fixed in OCTABAM4. OCTABAM4 (flashed 2 Oct 2026) saturated less than the plugin because the unit feeds FX 12 dB below DAW level; fixed in OCTABAM8 (plugin(4x)/4), which the author flashed and reported working the same day (a listening test, not a stress run).
gates: Worst-case cycles under parameter modulation on hardware
Real hardware stress project: eight audio tracks, at least 60 minutes

access.location: FUNC + FX1 or FUNC + FX2 SETUP on an audio track: the effect chooser (LEVEL selects, YES assigns). The five controls are on the FX main page.
steps: Select an audio track that plays a sample.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 (or FX1) to open its SETUP. Turn LEVEL to IRONOXIDE5 and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 (or FX1) to show the main page: INPUT, HIGH, LOW on the top row, OUT and MIX below. The SETUP page has no IronOxide5 controls.
Verified on the MKII panel of the emulator with the hardware test image; not yet on a unit.
